## Sources

- **Official NBA / Spurs:** season context, official schedule release, awards, and playoff results.
- **ESPN public JSON:** Spurs schedules, roster, game boxscores, play-by-play, and win probability.
- **Basketball Reference:** 2025–26 team ratings, schedules/results, and 2022–23 through 2025–26 player season tables.

See [SOURCES.md](SOURCES.md) for direct links and access notes.

## Snapshot catalog

| Snapshot | Grain | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `spurs_schedule_2026_27` | One row per assigned game | Schedule, title odds |
| `spurs_roster_2026_27` | One row per rostered player | Roster context |
| `spurs_schedule_2025_26` | One row per regular/postseason game | Rotation, Wemby, Finals |
| `spurs_player_boxscores_2025_26` | Player-game | Rotation, Wemby |
| `spurs_postseason_plays_2026` | Play | Finals |
| `nba_team_ratings_2025_26` | Team-season | Contenders, title odds |
| `nba_player_seasons_2022_26` | Player-team-season | Archetypes |
| `nba_games_2025_26` | Game | Validation and extensions |

Every snapshot is stored as portable CSV and efficient Parquet. `manifest.json` records row counts, schemas, and build time.

## Data contracts

Normalizers fail loudly when schedules or rosters are empty; feature functions assert required columns; tests cover invariants such as nonnegative travel, bounded probabilities, unique game IDs, and exactly five players in retained starter units.

## Responsible use

This is an educational portfolio, not an official NBA product. Provider data remains subject to each provider's terms. The repository caches raw responses locally but distributes analysis-ready extracts and source links. Refresh slowly and avoid parallel request bursts.
